description: Java DTO class 'NoteResponse' used for sending note data responses in a notes backend application, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing the note data sent in responses, including note id, title, content, creation, and update timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the note, returns the NoteResponse object for chaining.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note, returns the NoteResponse object for chaining.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content/body of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content/body of the note, returns the NoteResponse object for chaining.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the note was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the note.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the note was last updated.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp of the note.
